title: Context Pack Manifest (.halcyon/context_pack.json)
description: Workflow schema for project-specific context loaded by Authoring-Time Agents during Agentic Runs. This validates workflow metadata, not runtime Project Manifest content.

engine_context.description: Engine/tooling glossary, engineering, and ADR paths loaded for Agentic Runs.

project_context.description: Project-specific design, glossary, convention, and reference paths loaded for Agentic Runs.

reference_roots.description: Explicit read-only external roots that Agentic Runs may search for additional context. These roots are not project content, are not edited, and are not required for builds.

skills.description: Skill names made available to Authoring-Time Agents for this project.
